citations.text: Hanisch, S., & Eirdosh, D. (2023). Behavioral science and education for sustainable development: Towards metacognitive competency. Sustainability, 15(9), 7413.

en.general: Choosing one's own actions in line with values one has examined, an aim the design concept takes from education for sustainable development. The paper does not teach which behavior is right. It says that steering learners toward preset behaviors with nudging or messaging might add to concerns about indoctrination.

examples: A student picks a response that fits what she values after reflecting.
A class discusses which values matter to them.
nonExamples: A rule taught as the correct behavior.
